preregistration: E3R2 — reward-shaping fix for door-avoidance collapse
status: PROSPECTIVE — written before any R2 campaign data was generated or inspected
author: Agent 3 (statistical validation)

prior_evidence_used.note: R1 anchors from the completed validation campaign (research_data/validation/raw_e3.csv, 20 seeds/arm). Used ONLY for calibration constants and diagnosis; no R2 outcome was consulted.

drosophila_R1.verdict: collapsed: 100% of seeds reach openFraction<0.02 by training quarter 2

prior_evidence_used.diagnosis: Two compounding mechanisms: (1) SILENCE — a closed door generates zero crossing events, so the only learning channel (env.onCrossing -> controller.receiveFeedback) is inactive in the collapsed state; (2) VALUE ASYMMETRY — P(good) < 0.5 for every unselective policy, so E[feedback | open] < 0 = E[feedback | closed]; closing is reinforcement-learning-optimal even for engaged policies below classical selectivity.

forbidden: no changes to drosophilaController internals (weights, layers, plasticity rules, hysteresis latch)
no changes to experiment_core.js physics or trial engine
no changes to controllers.js or experiment_worker.js (branch has uncommitted collaborator edits; R2 is purely additive in new files)
no changes to env.onCrossing semantics, good/bad definition, or episode structure
intervention.implementation: e3r2_wrapper.js wraps the unmodified drosophilaController; the wrapper is the controller object seen by runBenchmark, translating/adding feedback events through the existing receiveFeedback bridge.

R2A_cost.description: Centered-cost shaping: (a) crossing feedback delivered unchanged (sign form the brain already maps to +/-1); (b) closed-door dwell cost kappa delivered as a synthetic punishment event {good:false, kind:'dwell_cost'} whenever the door target is 0, at rate kappa per simulated step (3.6 events per fully-closed 720-step episode).
R2A_cost.kappa_basis: Episode = 12 s x 60 Hz = 720 steps; the brain quantizes all feedback to +/-1 events, so calibration is in event rate. Two thresholds from R1 anchors: BREAKEVEN kappa_b = 1.69/720 = 0.00235/step (closed-door punishment rate exceeding the net punishment of blind opening) and EVENT-PARITY kappa_p = 8.5/720 = 0.0118/step (dwell events equaling the total crossing-event flux of an engaged episode, i.e. swamping). kappa = 0.005/step is the geometric midpoint of [kappa_b, kappa_p] => 3.6 dwell events per fully-closed episode, 2.1x breakeven, 0.42x parity. No post-hoc tuning permitted; any change requires a new preregistration (E3R3).
R2A_cost.calibration_note: An earlier draft of this file (same session, pre-outcome, never used to run anything) stated kappa=0.01 with a 300-step episode basis; corrected to 720 steps and event-rate framing before any R2 data was generated.
R2A_cost.target_state: applies while door.target==0 (the learned collapsed state), train phase only (plasticity gated by setLearning as in R1)

R2B_floor.description: Exploration floor ablation: no dwell cost, no feedback reweighting; during TRAIN phase only, each step the wrapper forces e.door.target=1 with probability floorP AFTER the brain's own decision (actuation overlay, network untouched). Tests the pure-engagement hypothesis: does feedback access alone suffice?
R2B_floor.role: pre-specified mechanism ablation (secondary family), not the primary hypothesis

shaped_frozen_control.description: Identical wrapper (same mode, same parameters) around drosophilaController with plasticity disabled via setLearning(false) in both phases — isolates whether LEARNING (not shaping per se) produces any gain.

unshaped_references.description: AMENDED PRE-OUTCOME: originally planned as reuse of archived R1 rows, but collaborators have modified controllers.js on branch deployment/phase-02 since R1, so the vanilla drosophila arm is RERUN in the current codebase at the same seeds (1..20) as part of the R2 campaign (arm name: vanilla_rerun). Archived R1 rows remain historical anchors only.

design.independent_replicate_unit: one seed = one independent replicate (300 TRAIN episodes with plasticity on, then 60 TEST episodes with plasticity off). Episodes/trials within a seed are NOT independent replicates.
design.seeds: 1..20, identical to R1; environment and controller streams derive from the same seed rule, giving exact matching across arms
design.test_window: TEST episodes 1..60 (learning disabled; post-learning policy readout)
design.environment: E3 pressure-door task, unchanged: nParticles/noise/doorHeight as in R1 campaign (CFG), dt=1/60

primary.name: P1_learning_under_shaping
primary.definition: Per-seed paired difference in mean goodMinusBad per TEST episode: R2A_cost minus shaped_frozen_control (R2A mode), same seeds.
primary.statistical_test: seed-level paired permutation test (sign-flip, 10,000 draws, two-sided) with seed-level Hedges' g and 95% t-CI (df=19)
primary.success_criterion: p_adjusted < 0.05 AND Hedges' g >= 0.5 AND engagement gate G1 met
primary.failure_criterion: 95% CI of the paired difference lies entirely <= 0, OR engagement gate G1 fails (verdict then FAILURE with mechanism label 'non-engagement' or 'no-learning-benefit' as appropriate)
primary.family: primary (family size 1, no multiplicity correction beyond reporting exact p)

engagement_gate.name: G1_engagement
engagement_gate.definition: In R2A_cost TEST phase: mean openFraction >= 0.10 AND proportion of episodes with >=1 crossing >= 0.50.
engagement_gate.basis: frozen reference openFraction=0.246, random=0.381; 0.10 = 40% of frozen reference, far above R1's collapsed 0.000; crossing-presence threshold keeps the learning channel verifiably alive
engagement_gate.joint_rule: P1 can only be declared SUCCESS if G1 also holds; G1 failure forces primary FAILURE regardless of the contrast outcome

secondary.family: secondary (BH-FDR q=0.05 across all secondary tests)

tests.name: S1_floor_ablation
tests.definition: R2B_floor vs shaped_frozen_control (R2B mode), same paired contrast as P1

tests.name: S2_package_effect
tests.definition: R2A_cost vs vanilla R1 drosophila (unshaped, matched seeds), paired test-phase goodMinusBad
tests.role: does the full shaping+learning package beat the collapsed baseline?

tests.name: S3_within_arm_gain
tests.definition: R2A_cost per-seed goodMinusBad late-train quarter (226..300) minus early-train quarter (1..75), paired

tests.name: S4_test_selectivity_positive
tests.definition: R2A_cost TEST-phase mean goodMinusBad > 0 (one-sided, CI lower bound > 0)
tests.role: absolute (not just relative) selectivity after learning

tests.name: S5_collapse_recurrence
tests.definition: fraction of R2A_cost seeds with TEST-phase openFraction < 0.02; success requires <= 10% (R1: 100%)

exploratory.note: Reported but never citable as confirmatory. dTfinal and sortEntropy are flagged DEGENERATE-INSTRUMENT: a permanently closed door scores as 'perfect sorting' on these (R1 lesson: hollow success).

instability_guard.name: G2_stability
instability_guard.definition: SD of per-seed TEST-phase goodMinusBad means in R2A_cost must not exceed 3x the shaped_frozen control's SD.
instability_guard.failure_action: if violated, verdict FAILURE with mechanism label 'shaping-induced instability'

statistics.ci: 95% t-CI on seed-level means and paired differences (df = n-1)
statistics.effect_size: Hedges' g (seed-level, bias-corrected); report g for every contrast
statistics.permutation: seed-level paired sign-flip permutation, 10,000 draws, two-sided; relative tolerance for tie handling as in stats_utils.js
statistics.multiplicity: BH-FDR q=0.05 within the secondary family; primary family has a single test
statistics.reporting: n, mean, SD, SE, 95% CI, median, effect size, and raw per-seed values for every primary/secondary endpoint
statistics.forbidden: trial-level CIs; permuting episodes instead of seeds; post-hoc endpoint substitution; re-running with adjusted parameters after seeing outcomes

deliverables.report: E3R2_REPORT.md with FACT / INFERENCE / EXPLORATORY labels and a final verdict of SUCCESS, FAILURE, or INCONCLUSIVE against these criteria
plots: learning trajectory (per-quarter goodMinusBad + openFraction, seed-level spread)

falsifiability.if_P1_fails_and_G1_holds: genuine finding: engagement restored but learning does not exceed shaping-only control; the architecture cannot exploit calibrated feedback on this task — report as FAILURE, do not tune parameters and retry (that would require a new preregistration, E3R3)
falsifiability.if_G1_fails: shaping magnitude/structure insufficient to break the absorbing state; report FAILURE with the kappa scale-analysis; any new kappa requires E3R3 preregistration
falsifiability.if_instability_guard_fails: report FAILURE with variance evidence; no outcome-driven smoothing or trimming permitted
